data.title: Invitation to appointment at immigration office
data.summary: The Berlin immigration office (Landesamt für Einwanderung Muster) invites Nora Musterova to an in-person appointment on 15 October 2026 at 10:45 about her residence permit extension application of 1 September 2026.
data.explanation: The immigration office needs to see you in person to process your extension application. Go to House B, waiting area 2, on 15 October 2026 at 10:45. Bring your passport, the current employer certificate (Arbeitgeberbescheinigung), your rental contract and a biometric photo. Your provisional certificate (Fiktionsbescheinigung) stays valid until a decision is made, so keep it safe. If you cannot attend, contact the office early using the contact details in the letter.
